units.source_text: 源氏走进秋好皇后帘内去了。

en.t: Genji went in behind Empress Akikonomu's curtains.

units.source_text: 夕雾中将看见走廊门口有许多侍女坐着，便走近去，和她们闲谈说笑。

en.t: Lieutenant General Yugiri saw many ladies-in-waiting seated at the entrance to the corridor, so he went over and chatted and joked with them.

units.source_text: 但因心事重重，神色沮丧，不像往日那样活泼。

en.t: But because his mind was heavy with worries, his expression was downcast, and he was not as lively as usual.

units.source_text: 不久源氏辞别皇后，立刻到北院去探望明石姬。

en.t: Before long, Genji took leave of the Empress and immediately went to the northern residence to visit Lady Akashi.

units.source_text: 这里没有干练的家臣，但见几个熟练的做杂务的侍女在庭中草地上走来走去。

en.t: There were no capable retainers here, only a few ladies-in-waiting skilled at odd tasks walking back and forth across the grassy garden.

units.source_text: 其中有几个女童，身穿美丽的衬衣，态度随意不拘。

en.t: Among them were several young girls wearing beautiful under-robes, moving about in a relaxed and unrestrained manner.

units.source_text: 明石姬爱好龙胆和牵牛花，曾经用心栽植。

en.t: Lady Akashi loved gentians and morning glories, and had once planted them with great care.

units.source_text: 如今这些花所攀附的短篱，都已被风吹倒，花也零落了，

en.t: Now the low fences these flowers had climbed were all blown down by the wind, and the blossoms too had fallen and scattered,

units.source_text: 这些女童正在收拾整理。

en.t: and these young girls were busy tidying everything up.

units.source_text: 明石姬愁绪满怀，独坐在窗前弹筝，听到了源氏的前驱人的呼声，

en.t: Lady Akashi, filled with sorrow, was sitting alone by the window playing the koto when she heard the cries of Genji's outriders,

units.source_text: 便起身入内，在家常服上加一件小礼服，以示礼貌。

en.t: so she rose and went inside, putting a small formal robe over her everyday clothes as a mark of courtesy.
This showed how thoughtful and attentive she was.

units.source_text: 源氏入内，就在窗前坐下。

en.t: Genji entered and sat down by the window.

units.source_text: 他只探问了些风灾情况，便匆匆辞去。

en.t: He merely asked a few questions about the damage from the storm, then hurriedly took his leave.

units.source_text: 明石姬意甚怏怏，独自吟道：

en.t: Lady Akashi felt deeply disappointed and quietly recited to herself:
